lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak jano ravai je har mano man pavan siu a(n)mrit peejai ||
lines.translation: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: meen kee chapal siu jugat man raakheeai udai nah ha(n)s nah ka(n)dh chheejai ||3||9||
lines.translation: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa muee na man muaa sar laharee mai mat ||
lines.translation: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in the world-ocean are intoxicating wine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਜਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bohith jal sir tar tikai saachaa vakhar jit ||
lines.translation: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanak man mahi man maarasee sach na laagai kat ||
lines.translation: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa takhat tikai gunee bhai pa(n)chaain rat ||1||
lines.translation: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the five qualities. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib door na dekh ||
lines.translation: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jot jagajeevanaa sir sir saachaa lekh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription on each and every head. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan rikhee munee sa(n)kar i(n)d tapai bhekhaaree ||
lines.translation: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanai hukam sohai dar saachai aakee marahi aphaaree ||
lines.translation: - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court of the True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਗਮ ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)gam jodh jatee sa(n)niaasee gur poorai veechaaree ||
lines.translation: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through the Perfect Guru, consider this:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin sevaa phal kabahu na paavas sevaa karanee saaree ||2||
lines.translation: without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord is the most excellent action. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਨਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidhaniaa dhan niguriaa gur ni(n)maaniaa too maan ||
lines.translation: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of the dishonored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulai maanak gur pakaRiaa nitaaniaa too taan ||
lines.translation: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of the weak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hom japaa nahee jaaniaa guramatee saach pachhaan ||
lines.translation: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is known through the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa naahee dar dhoee jhoothaa aavan jaan ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of the Lord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa naam salaaheeai saache te tripat hoi ||
lines.translation: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan ratan man maajeeai bahuR na mailaa hoi ||
lines.translation: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bighan na hoi ||
lines.translation: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sir de chhuteeai man tan saachaa soi ||4||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jugat naam niramaail taa kai mail na raatee ||
lines.translation: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stained by even a particle of dirt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਗਤਿ ਬੀਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: preetam naath sadaa sach sa(n)ge janam maran gat beetee ||1||
lines.translation: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death are ended for him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gusaaee teraa kahaa naam kaise jaatee ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tau bheetar mahal bulaavahi poochhau baat nira(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I can become one with You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahaman braham giaan isanaanee har gun pooje paatee ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: eko naam ek naaraain tribhavan ekaa jotee ||2||
lines.translation: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ ਤੋਲਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa da(n)dee ihu ghat chhaabaa tolau naam ajaachee ||
lines.translation: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; I weigh the immeasurable Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: eko haat saahu sabhanaa sir vanajaare ik bhaatee ||3||
lines.translation: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the one commodity. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dovai sire satiguroo nibeRe so boojhai jis ek liv laagee jeeahu rahai nibharaatee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focused on the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabad vasaae bharam chukaae sadaa sevak din raatee ||4||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantly serve, day and night. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਰਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਨਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oopar gagan gagan par gorakh taa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee ||
lines.translation: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of the World; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur bachanee baahar ghar eko naanak bhaiaa udaasee ||5||11||
lines.translation: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what is inside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11||
